# relay_documentdb_user (Resource)

A password user on a managed DocumentDB cluster, granted on every database. The username cannot change in place; the role and password can. `description` can be changed but not cleared. DocumentDB users have no IAM authentication and no expiry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_documentdb_user" "catalog_api" {
  workspace_id      = relay_workspace.prod.id
  cluster_id        = relay_documentdb_cluster.catalog.id
  username          = "catalog_api"
  role              = "admin"
  generate_password = true
}

resource "relay_documentdb_user" "reports" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  cluster_id   = relay_documentdb_cluster.catalog.id
  username     = "reports"
  role         = "readOnly"
  password     = var.reports_password
}

output "catalog_api_uri" {
  value     = "mongodb://${relay_documentdb_user.catalog_api.username}:${urlencode(relay_documentdb_user.catalog_api.generated_password)}@${relay_documentdb_cluster.catalog.endpoint_host}:${relay_documentdb_cluster.catalog.endpoint_port}/?tls=true"
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) `relay_documentdb_cluster` ID.
- `role` (String) `readOnly` reads every database. `admin` reads and writes every database and administers the cluster; DocumentDB has no write role without administration. Changing it updates the user in place.
- `username` (String) User name. `postgres` and names starting with `pg_` are reserved.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace of the cluster.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `generate_password` (Boolean) Let the platform generate the password. It is returned once in `generated_password`. An imported user's generated password cannot be recovered, so `generated_password` stays empty after an import.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password. Write-only on the API: changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `generated_password` (String, Sensitive) Generated password, stored in state. Not recoverable from the API.
- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<username>`.
- `phase` (String) Reconcile phase.
- `phase_message` (String) Detail for the phase.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_documentdb_user.catalog_api <workspace_id>/<cluster_id>/<username>
```
